races.name: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
DUBAI HONOUR's Australian efforts in the spring show he's still capable of very smart form as an 8-y-o and he's a potential class act on his return to Britain. On 3 lb better terms, Tabletalk can turn around recent York placings with Mount Atlas and fill the forecast spot.

  1. DUBAI HONOUR (IRE)
  2. TABLETALK (IRE)
  3. MOUNT ATLAS

races.name: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
races.verdict:
Although KINSWOMAN has failed to fire at listed/Group level recently she's worth chancing back in handicap company having returned to the same mark as when narrowly denied by a progressive sort on her Yarmouth reappearance. Rhythm N Hooves is another who has been cut some slack by the handicapper and is second choice ahead of the consistent Glamorous Breeze.

  1. KINSWOMAN
  2. RHYTHM N HOOVES
  3. GLAMOROUS BREEZE

races.name: TPT Fire Handicap
races.verdict:
The return to 7f looks a good move for SCOVILLE, who has shaped much better than his finishing position in top-end 1m handicaps on his last 2 outings. This is a touch less competitive than the races Great Acclaim has been contesting this summer and he's second choice ahead of Christian David, who may have gone close at Haydock last weekend but for meeting late trouble.

  1. SCOVILLE
  2. GREAT ACCLAIM
  3. CHRISTIAN DAVID (IRE)

races.name: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
William Haggas and Tom Marquand have combined to win this 3 times since 2021 so perhaps the exciting EXTREMELY ZAIN can improve past some more-established rivals, best of whom may be July Cup fourth Coppull if he's fully effective up at 7f. Last year's runner-up Witness Stand and former Group 1 winner Never So Brave are others likely to have a say.

  1. EXTREMELY ZAIN (FR)
  2. COPPULL
  3. WITNESS STAND

races.name: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Some interesting newcomers and a couple with good entries in MOSHEER and San Jose could be the pair to focus on before any betting clues. Mister Whippy and Gambling Man made promising debuts and should be in the mix with improvement.

  1. MOSHEER (IRE)
  2. SAN JOSE (IRE)
  3. MISTER WHIPPY (USA)

races.name: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Hopefully there's enough pace on for GREAT BEDWYN, who is lurking on a dangerous mark and may capitalise. Masterinthewoods and Tryfan also make plenty of appeal, while Pinatique will be interesting if supported on U.K. debut.

  1. GREAT BEDWYN
  2. MASTERINTHEWOODS (IRE)
  3. TRYFAN

races.name: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A field of interesting types, but a more conservative ride may see LOST SIGNAL land the spoils on first try over 1¼m. Dream Camp found a chunk of improvement at Windsor last time and has to be feared, while there should be more to come from recently gelded Bayaann.

  1. LOST SIGNAL (IRE)
  2. DREAM CAMP (IRE)
  3. BAYAANN

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap
races.verdict:
SEA OF CHARM is weighted to turn around last month's Bath form with Belle of Kt so is taken to get the better of Stan Moore's thriving 5-y-o this time. Tenadaay should also have a say if ready to roll after a 5-month break.

  1. SEA OF CHARM (FR)
  2. BELLE OF KT
  3. TENADAAY

races.name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Clive Cox's UNCLE FRANK is given a chance to build on a quite promising first run at Windsor at the start of the summer. Honeymoon Bear and He's Readytorumble have shown enough to suggest they could figure, while Snow On The Beach needs checking out in the betting having switched to the excellent James Owen yard since her debut in the spring.

  1. UNCLE FRANK (IRE)
  2. HONEYMOON BEAR (IRE)
  3. HE'S READYTORUMBLE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
WYLE COP may be able to follow up last weekend's C&D success. London Is Blue may give him most to do if bouncing back from a lesser effort at Windsor.

  1. WYLE COP (USA)
  2. LONDON IS BLUE
  3. ENTER SANDMAN (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
If LOGI BEAR can reproduce the level of last month's turf near miss at Nottingham he might be able to land a second career success. Far Too Fizzy has a win and close third to show from 2 previous outings over this C&D and is second choice ahead of Riley Rocks, who is nicely handicapped on his all-weather form from earlier in the year.

  1. LOGI BEAR (IRE)
  2. FAR TOO FIZZY
  3. RILEY ROCKS

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
SANSANETTI is in good form and can capitalise on this drop in grade. Monks Mead and Wrist Art also arrive in decent heart and complete the shortlist.

  1. SANSANETTI (IRE)
  2. MONKS MEAD
  3. WRIST ART (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
FALLACIOUS PROMISE is going the right way and can defy a penalty to notch his third win across his last 4 starts. Credit Forgedd It remains of interest on the strength of his Epsom second 2 starts back, with Dark Rosa taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. FALLACIOUS PROMISE
  2. CREDIT FORGEDD IT (IRE)
  3. DARK ROSA (IRE)

races.name: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Three well-bred newcomers from leading yards here, with preference on paper for Charlie Appleby's BIN JAHWAR, though it goes without saying the betting might provide the most clues.

  1. BIN JAHWAR (IRE)
  2. WAAQED (IRE)
  3. AL QAYED (IRE)

races.name: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
races.verdict:
HAVANA BLUE is going through a good spell and can build on last week's close second over C&D to snap a losing run. Act of Violence is low-mileage for the Tony Carroll yard and is feared most on the back of his Ripon success, with fellow last-time-out winner Archduke Ferdinand also considered.

  1. HAVANA BLUE
  2. ACT OF VIOLENCE
  3. ARCHDUKE FERDINAND (IRE)

races.name: Betway Bet 10 Get 40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
GREEN SKY's winning run ended at Salisbury on Thursday but she probably continues in form and can bounce back to winning ways if turned out again quickly. Alma Latina was a shade disappointing herself last time but will benefit from this step up in trip, with the reliable Dojin also shortlisted.

  1. GREEN SKY (IRE)
  2. ALMA LATINA
  3. DOJIN

races.name: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
EABHA's winning nursery debut over C&D is backed up a solid timefigure and on that evidence, a 5 lb rise may not prevent her completing the hat-trick. Princess Ivy and Fire Thunder look ready for 7f and are feared most.

  1. EABHA (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS IVY (IRE)
  3. FIRE THUNDER (IRE)

races.name: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
DEL CORSO has bossed a couple of small-field contests at Nottingham of late and it's easy enough to envisage him doing the same here. Pipily can offer most resistance.

  1. DEL CORSO
  2. PIPILY
  3. FEMME BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
STORMY MUSIC looked right at home on first try at 1m when successful here last week and on that evidence, further success beckons. Lightning Glory is a very consistent operator and can give the selection most to think about.

  1. STORMY MUSIC
  2. LIGHTNING GLORY (IRE)
  3. RENESMEE

races.name: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
races.verdict:
A quartet of in-form rivals to consider, with marginal preference for NORCROSS BROW, who has advertised the talents of his new trainer in recent weeks. Mister Mojito, Cherry Cobbler and Jersey Maverick all have something to recommend them.

  1. NORCROSS BROW
  2. MISTER MOJITO (IRE)
  3. CHERRY COBBLER

races.name: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PARK HALL has made a positive start for the Skeltons, scoring with plenty in hand in a Newton Abbot bumper and unlucky not to finish closer at the same course next time. She can go on to make a winning debut over hurdles at the expense of Jentobello and Centurion's Sister who have been holding their form in this sphere.

  1. PARK HALL (IRE)
  2. JENTOBELLO
  3. CENTURION'S SISTER (IRE)

races.name: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for ETERNAL ANGEL who has been going the right way for Tom Lacey this season, progressing again when third in a Cartmel handicap last month. With a sharp 2m in his favour he is fancied to land a third success of the campaign, though Loriko isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons.

  1. ETERNAL ANGEL (FR)
  2. LORIKO (FR)
  3. MAYO

races.name: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOG FOX didn't manage to build on his chasing debut effort in 2 subsequent outings last year, but after a couple of encouraging runs over hurdles he could yet do better back over fences. He is taken to get the better of Ghasham, who has been in good form sent chasing for this stable, while Belle Le Grand is one to note.

  1. DOG FOX
  2. GHASHAM (IRE)
  3. BELLE LE GRAND

races.name: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Last year's winner BELVEDERE BLAST looks to have been laid out for this, and he may well repeat the feat off a 3 lb lower mark. Ernest Gray could be a serious threat if back to his best on second start of the season.

  1. BELVEDERE BLAST (IRE)
  2. ERNEST GRAY (IRE)
  3. BALLINTUBBER BOY (IRE)

races.name: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Having eased in the weights, HUIT REFLETS ran well despite meeting trouble when second here last time and he can build on that effort as he returns to a longer distance. He gets the vote ahead of The Clonmel Kid, who has the form to be a contender back down in grade, with Huckleberry Sting also considered.

  1. HUIT REFLETS (FR)
  2. THE CLONMEL KID (IRE)
  3. HUCKLEBERRY STING

races.name: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ASHDOWN FOREST surely has more to offer for Dan Skelton based on the pick of his Flat form, so he looks capable of following up his recent Uttoxeter success. God of Fire has been handed a generous opening mark given his previous exploits on the level and should be a factor provided this doesn't come too soon after his comeback. Fine Point is also in good hands and may get back on the up following a break.

  1. ASHDOWN FOREST (IRE)
  2. GOD OF FIRE (IRE)
  3. FINE POINT (IRE)

races.name: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
PROJECT GEOFIN has yet to fire this season, but is now back down to the same mark as winning this race last year so is worth another chance following a breathing operation. Poet's Dawn isn't taken lightly, though in his bid for a 4-timer, with Canvas another to consider from a handy mark.

  1. PROJECT GEOFIN
  2. POET'S DAWN
  3. CANVAS

races.name: Skopes At Meadowhall Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ONE OF THE BOYS has been placed on all 3 career starts and can open his account switched to turf. The well-bred Wuood is clearly his main danger having showed enough when second on debut at Newcastle in March, for all he's not been seen since.

  1. ONE OF THE BOYS (IRE)
  2. WUOOD
  3. CERCIS

races.name: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NOBLE PRINCE made a promising start when keeping on for fourth at Yarmouth last month and, with his yard among the winners, he can build on that effort to open his account. Jessica is also open to improvement on the back of her first run and is feared most, ahead of well-bred newcomer Iwasjustsaying.

  1. NOBLE PRINCE
  2. JESSICA (IRE)
  3. IWASJUSTSAYING

races.name: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
races.verdict:
NYMAN has seemingly been working his way back to form in recent months, faring best of those held up when third in a stronger race at Redcar 7 days ago. Down to a handy mark, he can confirm the promise of that run back at 7f. C&D winner Thapa VC comes here thriving and is an obvious threat, as does Michael Dods' Imperial Guard, who is also a key player.

  1. NYMAN (IRE)
  2. THAPA VC (IRE)
  3. IMPERIAL GUARD (IRE)

races.name: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
races.verdict:
GOLDEN LONG is going the right way since joining this yard, making it 2 wins from his last 3 starts in a race that is working out really well at Newmarket, so he looks up to defying a 4 lb higher mark. Previous course winner Zubaru and the consistent Ancient State head the opposition.

  1. GOLDEN LONG (AUS)
  2. ZUBARU
  3. ANCIENT STATE (IRE)

races.name: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap (Rnd)
races.verdict:
CELTIC CHARIOT is getting the hang of things with back-to-back wins including over C&D and he looks capable of staying ahead of the handicapper for a while longer. Berlinetta has made an encouraging start for her new connections with a recent Windsor success and can build on that, while Vega's Virtue looked awkward under pressure last time but could be a threat if in the mood.

  1. CELTIC CHARIOT (IRE)
  2. BERLINETTA
  3. VEGA'S VIRTUE (IRE)

races.name: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
races.verdict:
SOUND GLORIA confirmed that she's on the up when keeping on well to score at Catterick last time and can continue her progress now that she's up and running. The 3-y-o is taken to see off the challenge of Is She Now, who has made a positive start for her current stable, while Alcanzor could yet do better.

  1. SOUND GLORIA
  2. IS SHE NOW (IRE)
  3. ALCANZOR (IRE)

races.name: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BIGGLES has come to hurdling late in the day but has shown enough in a pair of Uttoxeter novices to suggest he can win a race of this nature. Try Them is an obvious threat having returned to the pick of his juvenile form on first start for his new yard when runner-up over C&D last month, while Crackalackin also enters the reckoning back from a break.

  1. BIGGLES
  2. TRY THEM (IRE)
  3. CRACKALACKIN (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RAS KASSAR was unlucky to bump into an improved rival when runner-up at Uttoxeter last time, so he is taken to go one better as he makes only his third start for current yard. Tamarind Bay is feared most having won both of his chase starts so far, ahead of Follow Your Luck who is one to note on chasing debut.

  1. RAS KASSAR (FR)
  2. TAMARIND BAY (IRE)
  3. FOLLOW YOUR LUCK (IRE)

races.name: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LETS MINGLE proved much stronger at the finish returned to this C&D when deservedly opening her account 5 weeks ago and a token 2 lb rise should see her very competitive again. Fellow last-time-out scorer Follow Charlie rates an obvious threat, with Just Dottie another fancied to be thereabouts.

  1. LETS MINGLE (IRE)
  2. FOLLOW CHARLIE (IRE)
  3. JUST DOTTIE

races.name: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BROKEN ICE looks most interesting off a 2 lb lower mark than when successful in last year's corresponding race. October Hill and Drumlee Myth are the most likely dangers, ahead of hat-trick seeking Dalileo.

  1. BROKEN ICE (IRE)
  2. OCTOBER HILL (IRE)
  3. DRUMLEE MYTH (IRE)

races.name: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PURE GOLD looked ready to peak again when third here last month and appeals most at the weights. Summer Hurdle third Squeezebox and dominant Cartmel winner Filibustering are feared, while Useful Flat performer Nap Hand isn't taken lightly on second hurdle start for Chris Gordon.

  1. PURE GOLD
  2. SQUEEZEBOX (IRE)
  3. FILIBUSTERING

races.name: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
An unappealing bunch overall with COLLINGHAM receiving the tentative vote after showing clear signs of a revival off a plummeting mark at Uttoxeter on his most recent outing. Veteran Le Malin has possibilities if stepping forward from his comeback, while hat-trick seeker Edgewell can't be dismissed for all that he's likely to find it tougher going from his revised mark.

  1. COLLINGHAM (GER)
  2. LE MALIN (FR)
  3. EDGEWELL (IRE)

races.name: Scone Palace International Horse Trials NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateurs) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GAME SHADOW shaped well behind a subsequent winner on his Tramore debut for Paul Power in late May and is narrowly preferred to Downtown Nashville, who suggested he's in need of longer trips on his first start under Rules at Uttoxeter.

  1. GAME SHADOW (IRE)
  2. DOWNTOWN NASHVILLE (IRE)
  3. CAPTAIN MAINWARING (IRE)

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
CORAL COVE has made a promising start to her career and is in the right hands to continue improving, so she's fully expected to defy a penalty at the first time of asking. Tommo's Queen got the idea late on last month's debut at Redcar and is open to improvement over this extra 1f, while Rule of The Agency may fill the places once more.

  1. CORAL COVE (FR)
  2. TOMMO'S QUEEN
  3. RULE OF THE AGENCY

races.name: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROGUE JEWEL did well to come from off the pace and catch a pair with experience on their side when making a winning debut at York 3 weeks ago and is taken to maintain her unbeaten record en route to better things. Does Mary Know produced a promising first when sixth of 15 in a valuable maiden at Goodwood 18 days ago and is feared most ahead of Green Bay Dream.

  1. ROGUE JEWEL (IRE)
  2. DOES MARY KNOW
  3. GREEN BAY DREAM

races.name: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
WOODSTOCK made the frame in a better race than he need contest at Thirsk 2 weeks ago and, with the drop back in trip expected to suit, he gets the vote. Heading the list of dangers is Go Vince Go who has shaped encouragingly at York the last twice, with Roberto Caro and Magic Boy completing the shortlist.

  1. WOODSTOCK
  2. GO VINCE GO (IRE)
  3. ROBERTO CARO (IRE)

races.name: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
races.verdict:
LORD ROXBY has already landed a big-field handicap this season and is fancied to follow up his C&D success. Fast Track Harry still looks on a handy mark after last month's Ascot second, whilst last season's runner-up Kodiac Thriller is also respected on the back of his York success.

  1. LORD ROXBY (IRE)
  2. FAST TRACK HARRY
  3. KODIAC THRILLER (IRE)

races.name: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
races.verdict:
MURASHAH hasn't stood much racing to date but made a really encouraging start for his new yard when scoring at Thirsk back in April and he could progress further on the back of more time off. Swiped has some strong form to his name and is the pick of the 3-y-os so needs taking seriously, while Best Rate will be hard to keep out the placings in current form.

  1. MURASHAH (IRE)
  2. SWIPED
  3. BEST RATE

races.name: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
CLOCKER reverted back to her slow starting ways but it was encouraging she could match her previous best when runner up at Leicester 17 days ago (pulled long way clear of the remainder). She can confirm her mark to be an exploitable one, possibly at the chief expense of Wolverhampton scorer Blue Tulip, who appeals as the type to progress further in staying handicaps. Musical Accord didn't kick on as expected in maidens but this switch to handicaps can see her to better effect now.

  1. CLOCKER
  2. BLUE TULIP (IRE)
  3. MUSICAL ACCORD

races.name: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances but it's hard not to be impressed with how SAXON GRACE has advanced her form of late so a quick-fire hat-trick beckons if seeing out this trip. Tim Easterby holds a strong hand and his Little Ted and Sunny Orange are others to consider. Riddikulus and the returning Casilli at forecast longer odds also make appeal.

  1. SAXON GRACE (IRE)
  2. LITTLE TED
  3. SUNNY ORANGE (IRE)

races.name: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
MAWHIBAH split a pair of next-time-out winners at Limerick and looks the pick of those with experience. She's narrowly preferred to Paddy Twomey's interesting debutant Sea of The Celts, while Phlox may fare best of the remainder.

  1. MAWHIBAH (QA)
  2. SEA OF THE CELTS (IRE)
  3. PHLOX (IRE)

races.name: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
races.verdict:
Grade 1-winning chaser SOLNESS gets the vote on just his second start in this sphere. Well-related filly Glittering Gem could be a danger if building on a career-best effort, with Metallic and Davy Crockett both interesting on their respective debuts.

  1. SOLNESS (FR)
  2. GLITTERING GEM (IRE)
  3. METALLIC (IRE)

races.name: Morris DIY Rated Race
races.verdict:
A runner-up on handicap debut last time, MAXMINELLI is fancied to go one better. Feared most is Rodeo Blues, who could make a bold bid to resume winning ways.

  1. MAXMINELLI (IRE)
  2. RODEO BLUES (IRE)
  3. TANZANITE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
A repeat of the form LIMESTONE RED showed when second at Killarney might be good enough to see him land a first win on the turf. Last year's winner Stepdance is second choice ahead of Andrew McNamara's in-form 7-y-o Metamorpheus.

  1. LIMESTONE RED (IRE)
  2. STEPDANCE (IRE)
  3. METAMORPHEUS (IRE)

races.name: Perennial Freight Handicap
races.verdict:
RAKKI is down to a handy mark on the pick of his form for his previous yard and is put forward as the answer after shaping better than the distance beaten suggests on his first Flat outing for Willie Mullins recently. Daboya can bounce back returning to a more suitable grade, while Berto Ramirez is also of interest back on the level.

  1. RAKKI
  2. DABOYA (IRE)
  3. BERTO RAMIREZ

races.name: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
races.verdict:
SPASIBA was pulled up over hurdles when last seen in January last year but is well treated on old form reverting to this code and his top yard has few peers when it comes to getting horses ready after long absences, so he earns the vote. Dream On Baby was a wide margin winner of a C&D maiden on Thursday and has to be feared contesting her first handicap in this sphere under a 7 lb penalty. Filey Bay is entitled to strip fitter for his comeback and may fill the places.

  1. SPASIBA (FR)
  2. DREAM ON BABY (IRE)
  3. FILEY BAY (IRE)

races.name: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
A trappy low-level staying handicap with the vote going to VERVAIN, who found the line coming a stride too soon when just failing to double her tally at Gowran last week and seems likely to stay this longer trip on that evidence. Maxwell Smart has an ordinary strike rate but ran up to his best at Sligo on his most recent outing despite being left with a lot to do. God of Thunder and Bhean Saibhre are others to consider.

  1. VERVAIN (IRE)
  2. MAXWELL SMART (IRE)
  3. GOD OF THUNDER (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
INSTITUTE has disappointed to date given how well bred she is but she's surely up to winning a race like this and may prove suited by the drop to 5f. Grand Cuvee is going the right way and looks the most likely to capitalise if the selection fluffs her lines.

  1. INSTITUTE (IRE)
  2. GRANDE CUVEE (IRE)
  3. OSTERODE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
STARLIT shaped really well on debut in the Ballyhane Stakes at Naas last week and represents a yard with a good record with juveniles second time out this year. She's taken to overcome a high draw and open her account. Crayons In The Sky and Tosca No Candis are a couple of the other likely players.

  1. STARLIT (IRE)
  2. CRAYONS IN THE SKY
  3. TOSCA NO CANDIS (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Download Our App' Mourne Handicap
races.verdict:
SIR LES PATTERSON is a force to be reckoned with on the all-weather and is taken to bounce back returned to the venue of his last 2 successes. Valiant Force also needs to revive, but with 5 course wins to his name and having been dropped 4 lb, he must be respected, while I Bid You Ajou has been knocking on the door for some time and also merits consideration.

  1. SIR LES PATTERSON
  2. VALIANT FORCE (USA)
  3. I BID YOU AJOU (FR)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'First For Football' Apprentice Maiden
races.verdict:
PUNICA GRANATUM was unlucky not to beat the Sandringham winner at the Curragh in May and is taken to get back on track now reverting to maiden company for her all-weather debut. Emiza shaped well on debut and looks the chief threat, with further improvement on the cards, while the consistent Trek Home is also respected.

  1. PUNICA GRANATUM (IRE)
  2. EMIZA (FR)
  3. TREK HOME (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
ILE DE FRANCE wasn’t given a hard time on debut and is expected to prove a different proposition now upped in trip. Highest Order should also step forward from his debut and looks the chief danger, while Aachen makes plenty of appeal on pedigree and is capable of being involved if fully tuned up first time out.

  1. ILE DE FRANCE (USA)
  2. HIGHEST ORDER
  3. AACHEN (USA)

races.name: BAR 1 Casino 'Slot Games & Live Casino' Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
FAMOUS ENOUGH arrives after a brace of solid second-placed finishes and can go one better, though the participation of Reponse Finale, who is also declared at Cork on Friday would make his task significantly more difficult. Beau Army is also considered from the inside stall.

  1. FAMOUS ENOUGH (IRE)
  2. REPONSE FINALE (IRE)
  3. BEAU ARMY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
SLIEVE BINNIAN is very well treated on previous polytrack form and is taken to add a fifth course success to his résumé. Quatre Bras boasts a similar profile and is feared most, whilst Tribal Star won this race last year and is again fancied to run well.

  1. SLIEVE BINNIAN (IRE)
  2. QUATRE BRAS (IRE)
